user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with a very long guest name so that the system handles long string inputs gracefully.

positive.title: Create booking with a long guest name within allowable limits
steps: Enter a guest name consisting of 255 characters (the maximum allowable limit).
Complete the remaining booking details and submit the form.
positive.expected_result: The booking is successfully created without any errors, and the guest name is stored and displayed correctly.

negative.title: Create booking with a guest name exceeding allowable limits
steps: Enter a guest name consisting of 256 characters (one above the maximum limit).
Complete the remaining booking details and attempt to submit the form.
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that the guest name exceeds the allowable length limit and prevents form submission.

edge.title: Create booking with a guest name at the boundary limit
steps: Enter a guest name consisting of 255 characters (exactly at the maximum limit).
Complete the remaining booking details and submit the form.
edge.expected_result: The booking is processed successfully, and no errors are thrown for the guest name. The full name is stored and displayed accurately in the system.
